name: TSMC

eyebrow.en: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. · ADR (1 ADR = 5 shares) · Hsinchu, Taiwan
eyebrow.zh: 台积电 · 美国存托凭证（1 ADR = 5 股）· 台湾新竹

title.en: Every leading AI chip goes through one company's fabs.
title.zh: 每颗领先的 AI 芯片，都出自同一家晶圆厂。

lede.en: TSMC makes the chips that NVIDIA, Apple, AMD, Broadcom and Marvell design. Q3 revenue grew 41% in dollars to $46.7B, above the top of guidance, and Q4 is guided to $52.3–54.3B, up about 58% from a year ago. The costs are rising too: 2nm and overseas fabs pulled gross margin down to 66.4%, and capex stays at $60–64B for 2026 with more to come.
lede.zh: 台积电代工英伟达、苹果、AMD、博通和迈威尔设计的芯片。第三季美元营收增长 41% 至 467 亿美元，超出指引上限；第四季指引 523–543 亿美元，同比增约 58%。成本亦在上升：2 纳米与海外工厂令毛利率降至 66.4%，2026 年资本开支维持 600–640 亿美元，且未来更高。

s.zh: 2027 年一致预期每股收益 · 历史约 27 倍
2026 Q4 业绩及 2027 资本开支

sub_price.en: Daily closes of the NYSE-listed ADR with the 50-day average. Each ADR represents five Taiwan-listed shares.
sub_price.zh: 纽交所 ADR 每日收盘价与50日均线。每份 ADR 代表五股台湾上市股票。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions as reported by TSMC, with gross margin on the right axis. EPS is per ADR, converted from NT$ at each quarter's rate. The last bar is the midpoint of TSMC's Q4 2026 guidance.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元（按台积电公布的美元数字），右轴为毛利率。每股收益按每份 ADR 计算，以各季汇率由新台币换算。最后一根柱为台积电 2026 年第四季指引中值。

s.zh: 美元计同比 +41% · 高于指引

s.en: −1.3 pts QoQ on 2nm ramp · Q4 guide 65–67%
s.zh: 环比 −1.3 个百分点（2纳米爬坡）· Q4 指引 65–67%
晶圆营收占比 · 2纳米 8% · 7纳米及以下 79%
同比 +69% · 一致预期 4.42 美元
美元营收增长，原约 40% · 资本开支 600–640 亿

p.en: CEO C.C. Wei said demand still runs well ahead of supply. Full-year US$ revenue growth was raised again to about 44%, and the Q4 guide implies about 58% year-over-year growth.
p.zh: CEO 魏哲家表示需求仍远超供给。全年美元营收增长再度上调至约 44%，Q4 指引意味着同比增约 58%。

p.en: Operating margin of 58.7% beat the top of guidance even as 2nm diluted gross margin, helped by high utilization of 3nm and 5nm and price increases.
p.zh: 尽管 2 纳米摊薄毛利率，营业利润率仍达 58.7%，超出指引上限，受益于 3、5 纳米高稼动率及调价。

p.en: Gross margin fell 1.3 points to 66.4% on the 2nm ramp and is guided to about 66% in Q4. Overseas fabs cost about 2 points this year and should widen to 3–4 points as more US fabs ramp.
p.zh: 受 2 纳米爬坡影响，毛利率下降 1.3 个百分点至 66.4%，Q4 指引约 66%。海外工厂今年拖累约 2 个百分点，随更多美国工厂投产将扩大至 3–4 个百分点。

p.en: The 2026 budget stays at $60–64B ($40.6B spent through Q3), and management said 2026–2028 spending will be even more significantly higher than the past three years, with nearly 20 fabs under way.
p.zh: 2026 年预算维持 600–640 亿美元（前三季已支出 406 亿），管理层表示 2026–2028 年支出将比过去三年更显著增加，在建工厂近 20 座。

p.en: TSMC reports in NT dollars, and the ADR trades in US dollars. Each 1% move in the NT$ shifts gross margin by about 0.4 points.
p.zh: 台积电以新台币报告，ADR 以美元交易。新台币每变动 1%，毛利率约变动 0.4 个百分点。

p.en: Most leading-edge capacity is in Taiwan. Cross-strait tension and US chip tariffs are risks that no amount of earnings growth removes.
p.zh: 大部分先进产能位于台湾。两岸紧张局势与美国芯片关税属于盈利增长无法消除的风险。

p.en: TSMC publishes monthly revenue around the 10th of each month. Q4 guidance implies about NT$560–590B a month.
p.zh: 台积电约在每月10日公布月度营收。Q4 指引意味着每月约 5,600–5,900 亿新台币。

p.en: Two months of Q4 sales show whether it tracks the $52.3–54.3B guide.
p.zh: 两个月营收可显示 Q4 是否符合 523–543 亿美元指引。

p.en: Guide: $52.3–54.3B revenue, 65–67% gross margin, 56.5–58.5% operating margin. Also the 2027 capex budget.
p.zh: 指引：营收 523–543 亿美元，毛利率 65–67%，营业利润率 56.5–58.5%。另将公布 2027 年资本开支预算。

sources: Q3 2026 vs estimates and Q4 guidance (Zacks)

Quarterly income statement in NT$ (Stock Analysis)
Price, market cap and consensus EPS: Financial Modeling Prep, as of Oct 15, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 15, 2026 (Q3 2026 results). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月15日（2026 年第三季业绩）。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与台湾积体电路制造股份有限公司无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, converted from NT$ to US$ millions at each quarter's rate, for the 20 quarters from Q4 2021 to Q3 2026. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，按各季汇率由新台币换算为百万美元，涵盖 2021 Q4 至 2026 Q3 共 20 个季度。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: TSMC turns roughly 45–65% of revenue into operating cash, then spends a large share of it on fabs. Free cash flow dipped below zero only once in five years (Q2 2023). Q3 2026 was a record at about $15B: operating cash of NT$920B (~$28.8B) against $13.8B of capex.
read.zh: 台积电约 45–65% 的营收转化为经营现金流，再将其中大部分投入建厂。五年间自由现金流仅一次转负（2023 Q2）。2026 Q3 创纪录，约 150 亿美元：经营现金流 9,200 亿新台币（约 288 亿美元），资本开支 138 亿美元。

read.en: My base case uses the Q4 guide midpoint ($53.3B), operating cash at about 55–60% of revenue, and capex of about $21B in Q4 (the $60–64B budget less $40.6B spent through Q3), then $19–21B a quarter in 2027 as spending steps up again. That gives about $48B of free cash flow over four quarters. Capex is the swing factor: each extra $5B a year comes straight out of this number.
read.zh: 我的基准情景采用 Q4 指引中值（533 亿美元），经营现金流约为营收的 55–60%，Q4 资本开支约 210 亿美元（600–640 亿预算减去前三季已支出的 406 亿），2027 年每季 190–210 亿美元，四季自由现金流约 480 亿。资本开支是最大变数：每年每多 50 亿美元都直接从这里扣除。

p.en: 2026 capex of $60–64B, with $40.6B spent through Q3; 2nm, Arizona, Japan and advanced packaging are the big items.
p.zh: 2026 年资本开支 600–640 亿美元，前三季已支出 406 亿；2 纳米、亚利桑那、日本及先进封装为主要项目。

p.en: About NT$156B (~$4.9B) was paid in Q3 2026, and management reiterated a steadily rising dividend per share.
p.zh: 2026 Q3 派息约 1,560 亿新台币（约 49 亿美元），管理层重申每股股息稳定增加。

p.en: A fresh $100B commitment in Arizona adds to spending over the next several years.
p.zh: 在亚利桑那新增 1,000 亿美元承诺，未来数年支出进一步增加。

p.en: Q3 sales of NT$1.49 trillion were up 51% year over year and 18% from Q2, and Q4 is guided about 14% higher again.
p.zh: Q3 营收 1.49 万亿新台币，同比增 51%，环比增 18%；Q4 指引再环比增约 14%。

p.en: A 58.7% operating margin in Q3 means most incremental revenue drops to cash.
p.zh: Q3 营业利润率 58.7%，意味着大部分新增营收转为现金。

p.en: Roughly $126B of cash and securities earns meaningful interest income, which adds to operating cash.
p.zh: 约 1,260 亿美元现金及有价证券带来可观利息收入，计入经营现金流。

bridgeNote.en: TSMC's cash balance rose NT$488B in Q3 to NT$3.6T, with NT$4.0T including marketable securities. The NT$/US$ rate alone can move these dollar figures by several billion.
bridgeNote.zh: 台积电第三季现金余额增加 4,880 亿新台币至 3.6 万亿，连同有价证券为 4.0 万亿。仅新台币汇率变动即可使这些美元数字变动数十亿。

extraNote.en: Converted from NT$ using the rate implied by TSMC's own NT$ and US$ revenue for each quarter.
extraNote.zh: 以台积电各季新台币与美元营收所隐含的汇率换算。
